scope: Achievement replay inside the production character learning page

implementation.sharedView: CharacterLearningView; no duplicate challenge-card or star-slot layout
implementation.appearance: Current-city learning photograph, selected companion and level from the trial; system appearance, Dynamic Type and reduced-motion behavior are inherited from the shared page.
implementation.controls: Navigation-bar replay, settings menu and promotion button; no bottom control dock or forced dark stage. Trial preview hides the tab bar to match the standalone learning page.
implementation.receipt: Debug-only replay creates a positive memory receipt and uses the existing challengeClosed/load/star-award path. Model rejects replay commands for any service other than the dedicated memory service.
implementation.progress: Default 3 stars at 59/60 points; single replay adds the next star and ends at 0/60. First/ninth stars and multi-star boundary replay remain available.

regression.before: The new UI test failed because the old replay did not contain learning.challenge.card.
regression.runNote: The expected assertion completed in 18.360 s. Xcode then stalled in diagnostic collection; only this run's xcodebuild was stopped. Successful subsequent runs disabled diagnostic collection.

coverage: Real card, identity, chat progress, challenge action and history disclosure
Star flight ends in actual card slot with the updated points hint
Reachable while live services are unavailable; tab bar hidden
Maximum accessibility text with dark learning page on compact device

visualReview.method: Xcode-hosted interaction and native screenshots; Computer Use tools unavailable.
inspected: Trial entry with selected companion and no tab bar
Compact mid-flight and maximum-text dark page

preview.result: Built, installed and launched latest source; left the actual learning-page replay open on iPhone 18 Pro.

dataSafety: All new replay code is DEBUG-only. The replay service has no backend client, account store or persistent storage. No score policy, server, account data or production deployment changed.
limitations: Simulator screenshots do not measure physical-device haptic feel or GPU frame rate.
